facts.fact: At the Shilak Cairn Rohan asks 'And the medicine in your pack?', so Meera learns he knows she carries medicine (he found the redbark grain in ch 2). She reasons he has not seized it and cannot tell why, and answers with silence.
Meera moved the oilcloth roll of redbark from the fleece under the goat straps into the bottom of her own pack at the last halt before the avalanche.

During the bowl crossing Rohan ignores Meera's thirty-pace spacing and closes to a few paces behind her, which is how he reaches her when the slope slides. Meera notices and resents it; she tells him afterward to stay behind her where she ordered.
Rohan's post archive quotes the cairn rule only as 'One rope, one pair, until meltwater runs at this cairn.'
Meera thinks plainly, in her own head, that she is the Salt Fox and that Rohan would hang her at the thaw if he connected the two. She says nothing aloud.
